The country famous for the Great Barrier Reef is Australia.

The provided text exhibits significant bias through the use of hyperbolic and subjective language. Phrases such as "no other author has ever come close to the genius" and "single-handedly defined" are absolute statements that dismiss the contributions of other science fiction authors without evidence. The argument relies on emotional appeal and exaggeration rather than objective analysis, creating a one-sided perspective that elevates Isaac Asimov to an unassailable status while unfairly diminishing modern writers.
